info.title: Lodestar API
info.description: Every node is a new discovery. The JSON API under `/api/v1` (architecture §9): errors are always the `Error` envelope, and every path but the auth ones and this document needs the session cookie.

get.summary: Whether the instance is set up and the caller logged in.

Your classification rules, and how detection compares with your
corrections.

post.summary:
Your classification correction for one stored torrent; it's
classified again at once.

Adds a classification rule; the stored torrents it matches are
classified again.

Removes a classification rule; the torrents it matched are classified
again without it.

get.summary: The rule set, switches and lists.

post.summary:
Applies a change. A change that weakens filtering is refused with 428
(`confirm_required`, the assessment beside the error) until it's sent
again with the admin password, every time (§20.11).

get.summary: The core rules' hashed examples, run against the rules as they are.

post.summary:
What a change would do, without applying it or asking for the
password.
Starts a preview in the background; poll it by its id.

get.summary:
A preview job: progress while it runs, then the assessment (or the
error) once it's done.

post.summary: Cancels a preview job; it stops at its next step.

get.summary:
The review queue: quarantine (never with names) and the last 30 days'
decisions per rule.

post.summary:
Tries a draft rule and the current rules on example torrents. Nothing
is stored or logged.

200.description: Logged in; the session cookie is set.

post.summary: Clears the session cookie. The body is ignored but must be JSON.

get.summary:
Parses a query: the AST and its canonical text, or a `query_syntax`
error whose `start`/`end` span the UI highlights.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The query text; empty matches everything.

post.summary: Changes the password and ends every other session.

200.description: Changed; a new session cookie is set.

get.summary: Searches with query text. To search with an AST, POST it.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The query text; empty browses everything.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `relevance` (the default), or `discovered`, `size` or `files` with an optional `+` (ascending) or `-` (descending, the default).

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: `offset + limit` may not pass 10,000. Not with `cursor`.

parameters.name: hidden
parameters.description: Include torrents a filter rule hid (§20.3).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The previous page's `next_cursor`; send the same `q`, `sort` and `hidden` with it. An expired one is a 410 `cursor_expired`, a tampered one a 400 `bad_cursor`.

parameters.name: exact
parameters.description: `1` or `true`: count every match exactly, within a time budget.

post.summary: Searches with query text or a query AST.

Claims a fresh instance with the setup token from the logs and a new
password; logs in.

200.description: Set up; the session cookie is set.

get.summary: One torrent by any of its swarm hashes.
A page of a torrent's file list.

version.description: The rule set's version after the change.

Assessment.description: A change's assessment (§20.10, §20.11). Field order: see [`Preview`].

confirm.description:
The password is needed (every weakening change, and marking a list
as part of the locked floor).

oneOf.description: For a keyword override: the same entry as *Neutralize term*.

warning.description: The plain-language effect warning; null for a strengthening change.

oneOf.description: A keyword facet; matches any of the values.
Torrents with at least one file matching every clause of `of`.
A category's share of the files or bytes, inclusive percentages.

AstWhen.description:
One end of a date range: seconds before the search (`ago`), or a Unix
time (`at`).

setup_required.description:
No password yet: claim the instance with the setup token from the
logs.

oneOf.description: A pack (`malware`) or one pack rule (`MW-2`).

unless.description: An empty string removes the clause.

oneOf.description:
A quarantined torrent a rule caught wrongly (§20.12): an exception
for that torrent and that rule only, a hashed must-not-match
fixture for a core rule, and a release.

Releases a quarantined or dropped torrent: fetched and processed
normally next time it's seen.

Confirms a quarantined torrent as abuse material: into CS-1, sealed
name deleted.
Accepts or discards a version the sanity gates held back.

Change.description: One change to filtering (§20.7), tagged by `op`.

ChangeBody.description:
`POST /filters/preview`, `/filters/preview/jobs` and `/filters/apply`.
`Debug` shows whether a password was sent, never the password.

password.description:
The admin password, for a change that weakens filtering (§20.11);
ignored by previews.

queued.description:
Stored torrents queued to be classified again; null without a
search index (only torrents arriving later are affected).

query.description: Can't test `type:` or `adult:`: the rule decides them.

Classes.description:
`GET /classify`: your classification rules, and how detection
compares with your per-torrent corrections (§20.9).

CompositionShare.description: One colour group's share of a torrent (`docs/metrics.md` §4, §7.1).

bytes.description: Bytes in the group, padding excluded.

files.description: Files in the group, padding excluded.

pct_bytes.description:
Whole percent of the non-padding bytes: any non-zero share is at
least 1, and only a complete one is 100.

pct_files.description: The same, of the non-padding files.

floor.description: Part of the locked floor: can't be switched off.

CorrectBody.description:
`POST /classify/correct`: your correction to one stored torrent,
replacing any earlier one. `adult: null` and `not_junk: false` clear it.

shadow.description: Decided in shadow mode: recorded, not acted on.

checked.description: Corrections that say adult or not.

disagree.description: Of those, ones detection gets wrong.

code.description: A stable snake_case identifier to branch on.

end.description:
The end of the fault's byte span within `field` (query syntax
errors).

field.description: The request parameter or body field at fault (`sort`, `ast.field`).

start.description: The start of the fault's byte span within `field`.

ErrorEnvelope.description:
`{ "error": { … } }`, plus the rare top-level key a client needs to
recover.

assessment.description:
On a 428 from `POST /filters/apply`: the warning to show before
asking for the password.

setup_required.description: On a 401: whether the instance still needs its first-run setup.

FilesPage.description: `GET /torrents/{hash}/files`: a page of the file list.

failing.description: Examples the rule now gets wrong.

Fixtures.description:
`GET /filters/fixtures`: the core rules' hashed examples, run against
the rules as they are (§20.8).

JobStatus.description:
`GET /filters/preview/jobs/{id}`: progress while it runs, then the
assessment or the error.

error.description: Once `failed`: the error the preview would have returned.

MatchInput.description:
What an override, exception or allow entry matches, as sent: exactly
one of the four.

OkResponse.description: The body of a write that has nothing else to say.

scope.description: Applies only to what this query matches; null = everything.

Overview.description:
`GET /filters`: the rule set, switches and lists, as the Filters &
Safety screens show them.

ParseResponse.description: `GET /parse`: the AST and the canonical text it prints as.

PasswordRequest.description:
`POST /password`: ends every other session.
`Debug` redacts the secrets.

Preview.description:
What a change would do (§20.10). Counts come from the review queue,
the tombstones, the filter hits of the replay window and the index.

Fields are in the order `POST /filters/preview` has always sent them;
where an assessment is nested in another body, its keys are sorted.

caught_30d.description: Decisions in the replay window by the rules it affects.

core_caught_30d.description: Of those, by the child-safety core.

estimate.description:
Counts from names only (sealed names, no file lists), so files'
evidence isn't re-checked: treat as an estimate.

quarantine.description: Quarantined items it would release now.

stored.description: Stored items whose hide, demote or flag mark it would clear.

tombstones.description: Dropped items it would let be fetched again.

Queue.description:
`GET /filters/queue`: quarantine (never with names) and the replay
window's decisions per rule.

action.description: Null for an action code this server doesn't know.

shadow_until.description: Shadow mode ends then: until then it only records what it would do.

Sample.description: One example torrent for `POST /filters/test`, never stored or logged.

type.description: A content type (`movie`, `adult`, …), replacing the classifier's.

SampleFile.description: A sample's file: a path, or a path and its size.

SearchHit.description:
One search result: the torrent summary (`docs/metrics.md` §7.1), its
relevance and, for a query with a file clause, the files that matched.

composition.description:
What the torrent is made of, by colour group, in the composition
bar's order; groups without files are left out, and it's empty
before classification.

hash_v2.description: 64 hex digits; null for a v1-only torrent.

junk_reasons.description:
Stable reason keys (`docs/metrics.md` §7.1); empty when there are
none or before classification.

matched_files.description:
Positions in the torrent's file list; present only when the query
has a file clause.

resolved_via.description:
How the title was found when the name wasn't informative:
`files`, `folder` or `structure`; null = from the name itself, or
not classified.

title.description: The resolved title; null = not resolved.

trackers_checked.description:
Trackers that answered in the last answered round; null = never
scraped.

trackers_reporting.description: Of those, trackers that reported anyone; null = never scraped.

SearchRequest.description:
`POST /search`'s body, and `GET /search`'s parameters (where `ast` is
refused: send an AST with POST).

oneOf.description:
A query AST, as `/parse` returns it; it must be one the parser
could produce.

cursor.description:
The previous page's `next_cursor`, to read the next page from the
same index snapshot. Send the same `q` (or `ast`), `sort` and
`hidden` with it.

exact.description:
Count every match exactly, even above 100,000 (within a time
budget; `total_approx` says whether it made it). `1` or `true`.

hidden.description: Include torrents a filter rule hid (§20.3).

offset.description: `offset + limit` may not pass 10,000. Not with `cursor`.

q.description: The query text. Send `q` or `ast`, not both.

sort.description:
`relevance` (the default), or `discovered`, `size` or `files` with
an optional `+` (ascending) or `-` (descending, the default).

canonical.description: The query as the server understood it.

next_cursor.description:
Pass as `cursor` for the next page, read from the same index
snapshot (§8); null on the last page. Opaque, URL-safe, at most
256 characters, valid for 10 minutes after its last use.

stemmed.description:
Few exact matches: plural forms in titles were included too (§8),
ranked after the exact ones.

total.description: Matches in all, not just this page.

total_approx.description:
`total` is an estimate (above 100,000 matches; shown with "≈");
ask with `exact` for the exact count.

SetupRequest.description:
`POST /setup`: claims the instance.
`Debug` redacts the secrets.

token.description:
The one-time token printed to the logs (`XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX`, any
case).

SwarmSample.description:
One day or week of swarm history. Counts saturate at 65,534; null is
a gap.

at.description:
The start of the UTC day, or of the week (epoch day / 7: weeks
start on Thursday).

TestBody.description: `POST /filters/test`: a draft rule and examples to try it on.

oneOf.description: What the current rules decide; null = nothing.

draft.description: Whether the draft matches; null without a draft.

shadow.description: Rules in shadow mode that would have decided.

TorrentDetail.description:
`GET /torrents/{hash}`: the torrent summary (`docs/metrics.md` §7.1),
its swarm section (§7.2) and the first 500 files.

The swarm fields are `null` until swarm health is served (M4): null is
"never scraped", never 0.

dht_peers.description: BEP 33 estimate of peers (always approximate); null = no estimate.

dht_seeds.description: BEP 33 estimate of seeds (always approximate); null = no estimate.

file_list.description: The first files, in the torrent's order; the rest via `/files`.

hash_v2.description: 64 hex digits; null for a v1-only torrent.

oneOf.description:
14 daily and 26 weekly samples, newest first; null = no history
kept.

swarm_trend.description:
Seeders per day over the last week; null = fewer than 3 daily
samples.

trackers_checked.description:
Trackers that answered in the last answered round; null = never
scraped.

trackers_reporting.description: Of those, trackers that reported anyone; null = never scraped.

Error.description: Any failure: the error envelope. `error.code` is stable; branch on it.

session.name: lodestar_session
session.description: The session cookie `/setup`, `/login` and `/password` set. HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict.
